notes:
## Changelog
- Fixed breaking out a strip doesn't regenerate CID.
- Fixed duplicating a column or duplicating a split, copy squawk and CID.
- Fixed server client handshake is delayed by the "Connected" popup.
- Fixed column rename de-syncs UI from model.
- Fixed strips keep the old column name after column rename.
- Fixed "remove field" button can't remove border boxes on strip layout editor.
- Fixed profile switcher shows "(unsaved)" for saved custom profiles.
- Fixed "check for updates" gives no feedback when you're up to date.
- Fixed cloning a preset silently overwrites an existing custom layout.
- Fixed collapse dialog offers strips owned by other controllers.
- Fixed stopping a server doesn't properly disconnects all clients in certain scenarios.
- Fixed offline strips get hidden after connecting to a server.
- Fixed deleting a column deletes other controllers' strips.
- Fixed a rejected transfer leaves the strip on the rejecter's board.
- Fixed renaming the default layout can leave a dead default path.
- Fixed overlapping update checks read the wrong reply.
- Fixed the first dialog edit silently changes Type from "" to "Unknown".
- Fixed bulk add accepts invalid squawks.
- Fixed overview tab rebuilding every strip on every edit, even when hidden.
- Added ability to create a strip or spacer (more specifically when using keybinds) go to the column you are hovering with your mouse, not just the first column.
- Added changelog history to show list of changes by update, not just latest update.
- Changed column duplication to no longer duplicate any spacers or strips inside it,.
